ddl.definition:
with months as (
    select generate_series(
      date_trunc('month', now() at time zone 'Europe/London') - interval '12 months',
      date_trunc('month', now() at time zone 'Europe/London'),
      interval '1 month'
    )::date as month
  ),
  rate as (
    select coalesce(
      (select (value #>> '{}')::numeric from settings where key = 'ct_set_aside_rate'),
      0.2
    ) as r
  ),
  agg as (
    -- Sales are credits; costs are debits (negated credits).
    select
      date_trunc('month', l.date)::date as period_start,
      coalesce(sum(l.credit) filter (where g."group" = 'sales'), 0) as sales,
      coalesce(-sum(l.credit) filter (where g."group" = 'people'), 0) as people,
      coalesce(-sum(l.credit) filter (where g."group" = 'other'), 0) as other
    from v_ledger_line l
    join account_group g on g.account_id = l.account_id
    group by 1
  ),
  synced as (
    select max(last_completed_at) as as_of
    from sync_cursor
    where resource in ('invoices', 'credit_notes', 'bank_transactions', 'manual_journals')
  )
  select
    m.month,
    coalesce(a.sales, 0)::numeric(14, 2) as sales,
    coalesce(a.people, 0)::numeric(14, 2) as people_costs,
    coalesce(a.other, 0)::numeric(14, 2) as other_costs,
    (coalesce(a.sales, 0) - coalesce(a.people, 0) - coalesce(a.other, 0))::numeric(14, 2) as profit,
    case when coalesce(a.sales, 0) <> 0
      then round((a.sales - a.people - a.other) / a.sales, 4)
    end as margin,
    round(coalesce(a.sales, 0) * rate.r, 2)::numeric(14, 2) as ct_set_aside,
    synced.as_of
  from months m
  cross join rate
  left join agg a on a.period_start = m.month
  cross join synced
  order by m.month
ddl.name: v_pnl_monthly

ddl.definition:
with today as (select (now() at time zone 'Europe/London')::date as d),
  fy_setting as (
    select
      coalesce((select (value ->> 'month')::int from settings where key = 'financial_year_start'), 4) as m,
      coalesce((select (value ->> 'day')::int from settings where key = 'financial_year_start'), 1) as dd
  ),
  fy as (
    select case
      when t.d >= make_date(extract(year from t.d)::int, s.m, s.dd)
        then make_date(extract(year from t.d)::int, s.m, s.dd)
      else make_date(extract(year from t.d)::int - 1, s.m, s.dd)
    end as start
    from today t cross join fy_setting s
  ),
  docs as (
    select d.*, fy.start as fy_start from v_sales_document d cross join fy
  ),
  per_client as (
    select
      contact_id,
      min(fy_start) as fy_start,
      coalesce(sum(net_gbp) filter (where date >= fy_start), 0) as invoiced_fy,
      coalesce(sum(net_gbp) filter (where date >= fy_start - interval '1 year' and date < fy_start), 0) as invoiced_prev_fy,
      sum(outstanding_gbp) as outstanding,
      round(avg(days_to_pay), 1) as avg_days_to_pay,
      max(date) filter (where kind = 'invoice') as last_invoice_date,
      count(*) filter (where kind = 'invoice' and date >= fy_start)::int as invoices_fy
    from docs
    group by contact_id
  ),
  paid_fy as (
    select r.contact_id, sum(r.paid_gbp) as amount
    from v_revenue_by_client_month r cross join fy
    where r.month >= date_trunc('month', fy.start)
    group by r.contact_id
  ),
  total as (
    select nullif(sum(invoiced_fy), 0) as t, nullif(sum(invoiced_prev_fy), 0) as t_prev
    from per_client
  )
  select
    pc.contact_id,
    coalesce(c.name, 'Unknown contact') as name,
    pc.fy_start,
    pc.invoiced_fy::numeric(14, 2),
    pc.invoiced_prev_fy::numeric(14, 2),
    round(pc.invoiced_fy / total.t, 4) as share_fy,
    round(pc.invoiced_prev_fy / total.t_prev, 4) as share_prev_fy,
    coalesce(p.amount, 0)::numeric(14, 2) as paid_fy,
    pc.outstanding::numeric(14, 2),
    pc.avg_days_to_pay,
    pc.last_invoice_date,
    pc.invoices_fy,
    round(pc.invoiced_fy / nullif(pc.invoices_fy, 0), 2)::numeric(14, 2) as avg_invoice_fy
  from per_client pc
  cross join total
  left join xero_contact c on c.contact_id = pc.contact_id
  left join paid_fy p on p.contact_id is not distinct from pc.contact_id
ddl.name: v_client_summary

ddl.definition:
with invoiced as (
    select contact_id, date_trunc('month', date)::date as month, sum(net_gbp) as amount
    from v_sales_document
    group by 1, 2
  ),
  paid as (
    select i.contact_id, date_trunc('month', p.date)::date as month,
      sum(round(coalesce(p.amount, 0) / coalesce(nullif(p.currency_rate, 0), 1), 2)) as amount
    from xero_payment p
    join xero_invoice i on i.invoice_id = p.invoice_id
    where i.type = 'ACCREC' and p.status = 'AUTHORISED' and p.date is not null
    group by 1, 2
  )
  select
    coalesce(i.contact_id, p.contact_id) as contact_id,
    coalesce(i.month, p.month) as month,
    coalesce(i.amount, 0)::numeric(14, 2) as invoiced_gbp,
    coalesce(p.amount, 0)::numeric(14, 2) as paid_gbp
  from invoiced i
  full join paid p on p.contact_id is not distinct from i.contact_id and p.month = i.month
ddl.name: v_revenue_by_client_month

ddl.definition:
select
    invoice_id as document_id,
    'invoice' as kind,
    contact_id,
    date,
    round(coalesce(sub_total, 0) / coalesce(nullif(currency_rate, 0), 1), 2) as net_gbp,
    round(coalesce(total, 0) / coalesce(nullif(currency_rate, 0), 1), 2) as gross_gbp,
    round(coalesce(amount_due, 0) / coalesce(nullif(currency_rate, 0), 1), 2) as outstanding_gbp,
    case when status = 'PAID' and fully_paid_on_date is not null
      then fully_paid_on_date - date end as days_to_pay
  from xero_invoice
  where type = 'ACCREC' and status in ('AUTHORISED', 'PAID') and date is not null
  union all
  select
    credit_note_id,
    'credit_note',
    contact_id,
    date,
    -round(coalesce(sub_total, 0) / coalesce(nullif(currency_rate, 0), 1), 2),
    -round(coalesce(total, 0) / coalesce(nullif(currency_rate, 0), 1), 2),
    0,
    null
  from xero_credit_note
  where type = 'ACCRECCREDIT' and status in ('AUTHORISED', 'PAID') and date is not null
ddl.name: v_sales_document

ddl.definition:
with doc_lines as (
    select 'invoice' as source, i.invoice_id as document_id, i.date, i.contact_id,
      l.value as li, i.line_amount_types as lat,
      coalesce(nullif(i.currency_rate, 0), 1) as rate,
      case i.type when 'ACCREC' then 1 else -1 end as dir
    from xero_invoice i
    cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(i.raw -> 'LineItems', '[]')) l
    where i.type in ('ACCREC', 'ACCPAY') and i.status in ('AUTHORISED', 'PAID')
    union all
    select 'credit_note', c.credit_note_id, c.date, c.contact_id,
      l.value, c.raw ->> 'LineAmountTypes',
      coalesce(nullif(c.currency_rate, 0), 1),
      case c.type when 'ACCRECCREDIT' then -1 else 1 end
    from xero_credit_note c
    cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(c.raw -> 'LineItems', '[]')) l
    where c.status in ('AUTHORISED', 'PAID')
    union all
    select 'bank_transaction', b.bank_transaction_id, b.date, b.contact_id,
      l.value, b.raw ->> 'LineAmountTypes',
      coalesce(nullif(b.currency_rate, 0), 1),
      case b.type when 'RECEIVE' then 1 else -1 end
    from xero_bank_transaction b
    cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(b.raw -> 'LineItems', '[]')) l
    where b.type in ('RECEIVE', 'SPEND') and b.status = 'AUTHORISED'
  )
  select
    d.source,
    d.document_id,
    d.date,
    a.account_id,
    d.contact_id,
    d.li ->> 'Description' as description,
    round(
      d.dir * (
        coalesce((d.li ->> 'LineAmount')::numeric, 0)
        - case when d.lat = 'Inclusive' then coalesce((d.li ->> 'TaxAmount')::numeric, 0) else 0 end
      ) / d.rate,
      2
    )::numeric(14, 2) as credit
  from doc_lines d
  join xero_account a
    on a.account_id::text = d.li ->> 'AccountID'
    or (d.li ->> 'AccountID' is null and a.code = d.li ->> 'AccountCode')
  where d.date is not null
  union all
  select
    'manual_journal',
    j.manual_journal_id,
    j.date,
    a.account_id,
    null,
    coalesce(l.value ->> 'Description', j.narration),
    (-coalesce((l.value ->> 'LineAmount')::numeric, 0))::numeric(14, 2)
  from xero_manual_journal j
  cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(j.raw -> 'JournalLines', '[]')) l
  join xero_account a on a.account_id::text = l.value ->> 'AccountID'
  where j.status = 'POSTED' and j.date is not null
ddl.name: v_ledger_line

ddl.definition:
select
    l.contact_id,
    coalesce(c.name, 'Unassigned') as name,
    date_trunc('month', l.date)::date as month,
    (-sum(l.credit))::numeric(14, 2) as amount,
    count(distinct l.document_id) as payments
  from v_ledger_line l
  join account_group g on g.account_id = l.account_id and g."group" = 'people'
  join xero_account a on a.account_id = l.account_id
  left join xero_contact c on c.contact_id = l.contact_id
  where a.name !~* 'director'
  group by 1, 2, 3
ddl.name: v_staff_pay_monthly

ddl.definition:
with today as (select (now() at time zone 'Europe/London')::date as d)
  select
    i.invoice_id,
    i.invoice_number,
    i.contact_id,
    coalesce(c.name, 'Unknown contact') as client,
    i.date,
    i.due_date,
    greatest(0, t.d - coalesce(i.due_date, i.date))::int as days_overdue,
    case
      when t.d <= coalesce(i.due_date, i.date) then 'Not yet due'
      when t.d - coalesce(i.due_date, i.date) <= 30 then '1–30 days overdue'
      when t.d - coalesce(i.due_date, i.date) <= 60 then '31–60 days overdue'
      when t.d - coalesce(i.due_date, i.date) <= 90 then '61–90 days overdue'
      else 'Over 90 days overdue'
    end as bucket,
    round(i.amount_due / coalesce(nullif(i.currency_rate, 0), 1), 2)::numeric(14, 2) as outstanding_gbp
  from xero_invoice i
  cross join today t
  left join xero_contact c on c.contact_id = i.contact_id
  where i.type = 'ACCREC' and i.status = 'AUTHORISED' and i.amount_due > 0
ddl.name: v_aged_debtors

ddl.definition:
with today as (select (now() at time zone 'Europe/London')::date as d),
  s as (
    select
      coalesce((select (value ->> 'month')::int from settings where key = 'financial_year_start'), 4) as m,
      coalesce((select (value ->> 'day')::int from settings where key = 'financial_year_start'), 1) as dd
  ),
  start as (
    select case
      when t.d >= make_date(extract(year from t.d)::int, s.m, s.dd)
        then make_date(extract(year from t.d)::int, s.m, s.dd)
      else make_date(extract(year from t.d)::int - 1, s.m, s.dd)
    end as fy_start
    from today t cross join s
  )
  select fy_start, (fy_start + interval '1 year' - interval '1 day')::date as fy_end
  from start
ddl.name: v_current_fy

ddl.definition:
select
    l.contact_id,
    coalesce(c.name, 'Unassigned') as director,
    fy.fy_start,
    coalesce(-sum(l.credit) filter (where a.class = 'EXPENSE'), 0)::numeric(14, 2) as salary_gbp,
    coalesce(-sum(l.credit) filter (where a.class = 'EQUITY'), 0)::numeric(14, 2) as dividends_gbp,
    (-sum(l.credit))::numeric(14, 2) as total_gbp
  from v_ledger_line l
  join xero_account a on a.account_id = l.account_id
  cross join v_current_fy fy
  left join xero_contact c on c.contact_id = l.contact_id
  where l.date >= fy.fy_start
    and (
      (a.class = 'EXPENSE' and a.name ~* 'director')
      or (a.class = 'EQUITY' and a.name ~* 'dividend')
    )
  group by 1, 2, 3
ddl.name: v_take_home_ytd
